usedFor: LionDesk is a real estate CRM, where “New Contact” starts a step and “Start Campaign” follows up with that contact.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Create Contact” in LionDesk
bestTemplate.why: An incoming message becomes a LionDesk contact, so a new lead is not lost in a chat.

watchOut: “New Contact” is polling, so it runs on a scheduled check and a short delay is normal.
